claim: Finvest is regulated, and by whom
Treasury bills are recorded against each client's own account at a custodian ("Held in your name", "Your bills, your name")
Client money lands in a collection account kept apart from Finvest's own money
Finvest's records are checked against mobile money, bank and custodian statements every day, and a second person signs off
Interest is earned every day and shown daily, after tax
A treasury bill held to maturity pays the amount shown when the client invests
Finvest does not lend client money out
Accounts are audited each year, and personal data is handled under the Data Protection and Privacy Act, 2019
Support hours, reply within one working day, complaints acknowledged within one working day
Joint, group, SACCO and company accounts, and goals, are offered
